concepts.name: 지식의 등불
concepts.motif: An emerald lantern with warm ivory light and substantial sculpted gold framing.
concepts.progression: 5: a small simple lantern. 10: a wider lantern with two ivory light panes. 100: a stronger lantern resting above one open book. 1,000: a mature teaching lantern with broad rays and a three-book base. No actual glow beyond the badge.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / product-mockup.
Create ONE landscape comparison sheet about 2.4:1 aspect ratio showing EXACTLY FOUR premium physical clan enamel pins in one evenly spaced horizontal row, left to right 5, 10, 100, 1,000 milestones.
Family: 지식의 등불. Outer contour shared across all four: a tall arched shield. Motif: An emerald lantern with warm ivory light and substantial sculpted gold framing.
Specific growth progression, left to right: 5: a small simple lantern. 10: a wider lantern with two ivory light panes. 100: a stronger lantern resting above one open book. 1,000: a mature teaching lantern with broad rays and a three-book base. No actual glow beyond the badge.
Materials: rich emerald, pale mint and warm ivory HARD ENAMEL, substantial polished WARM GOLD metal rim and seams, realistic jewelry relief, crisp dimensional bevels and controlled highlights. Gold finish remains identical for every tier. Strong readable silhouettes at 80px, restrained bold forms. No black/silver tier rim, bronze recoloring, emoji, flat app icons, thin vector doodles, real people, watermarks, game logos or branded symbols.
The internal illustration grows through the specified stages; do not just swap a numeral or border color. Keep all objects fully inside the common outer contour.
Presentation: uniform matte charcoal #151918 backdrop, front-facing upright pins, same lighting and maximum pin height, generous spacing, every complete badge clearly visible. Add ONLY plain ivory numeric captions "5", "10", "100", "1,000" OUTSIDE and centered below their corresponding pins. No other lettering, no numerals on the actual jewelry. No case, background scenery, giant frames, glowing effects or missing tiers.

concepts.name: 열린 배움

concepts.progression: 5: one plain open book. 10: an open book with one small gold quill. 100: three layered volumes and a larger quill. 1,000: five layered volumes supporting the open central book and an elegant emerald ribbon. No printed letters on pages.
